page.notes: Printed page 738 with running head at top. The reference marks "--", "·", "1" to "4" stand in the left margin beside the list of four kinds of precepts; they are copied as notes. Doubtful readings: "a se praeceptis" (first letter of "á" uncertain), "nox quidem" (the "x" may be a long-s/x ligature), "bone" in "Ecclesiasticae bone" (may be "bonae"), "instinctu" in the "Ob. 2." paragraph. The word at the end of the last line, "iftis", is the catchword. The printed "Ministe-rii" was joined across the line end. The right-edge show-through and page edge were not transcribed.
